views.name: active_users
views.sql: SELECT u.name, u.country, COUNT(*) AS events FROM users u JOIN events e ON e.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY u.name, u.country ORDER BY events DESC

views.name: revenue_by_region
views.sql: SELECT r.region, SUM(e.amount) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS n FROM events e JOIN users u ON u.user_id = e.user_id JOIN regions r ON r.country = u.country WHERE e.amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY revenue DESC

views.name: saved_view_1
views.sql: SELECT region, signups FROM region_totals ORDER BY signups DESC;

saved_queries.name: cross-file join
saved_queries.sql:
SELECT u.country, e.action, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(e.amount) AS total
FROM events e
JOIN users u ON e.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE e.amount IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY u.country, e.action
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 20;

saved_queries.name: files x database
saved_queries.sql:
-- One join across a parquet file, a CSV and a live PostgreSQL, all unqualified.
SELECT r.region, u.name, count(*) AS orders, sum(o.total) AS spend
FROM orders o
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = o.user_id
JOIN regions r ON r.country = u.country
GROUP BY r.region, u.name
ORDER BY spend DESC;

saved_queries.name: nbas
saved_queries.sql:
WITH items AS (SELECT unnest(nba['nbas']) AS i FROM config)
SELECT UNNEST(i)
FROM items

saved_queries.name: orders (unqualified)
saved_queries.sql:
-- 'orders' is only in the database, so it resolves there with no qualifier.
SELECT order_id, user_id, sku, quantity, total, placed_at
FROM orders
ORDER BY placed_at;

saved_queries.name: same name, two sources
saved_queries.sql:
-- A bare name is the project's own: 'products' is products.parquet. The database has a
-- products table too, and it is reached by naming the connection.
SELECT p.name, v.sku, v.price, s.supplier, s.unit_cost, s.lead_time_days
FROM products p
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(p.variants) AS v
JOIN pg.public.products s ON s.sku = v.sku
ORDER BY p.name;

saved_queries.name: top spenders
saved_queries.sql:
SELECT u.name, SUM(e.amount) AS spend
FROM users u
JOIN events e ON e.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE e.action = 'purchase'
GROUP BY u.name
ORDER BY spend DESC;
